# Python

![Python function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/connectivity.python.svg)

[Connectivity functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Author Python sessions and extensible Python Node signatures. The return type controls the result connector; no Python code is executed while editing.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Open Python Session](python/open_session.md) | Opens a Python session for the specified version so multiple Python Nodes can share that process. |
| [Python Node](python/node.md) | Calls a configured Python function with extensible typed arguments and a return value determined by return type. |
| [Close Python Session](python/close_session.md) | Closes a Python session, including when a previous node has returned an error. |
